entries: The {rival} was a copy, printed {MANNER} out of {MOTIVE}.
{the_someone} was the mind of {place}, speaking through a borrowed body.
{the_thing:!living} held the last human memory on {place}, and {first} had nearly wiped it.
The mind of {place} staged {the_disaster:strikes} as a test, out of {MOTIVE}.
{CLOSE:human} had died crossing to {place}; this one was rebuilt.
The signal from {landmark} was {first}'s own, sent back {MANNER} from a failed future.
{the_message:physical} had been sent by {SOMEONE:!plural}, centuries before {place} was founded.
{first} was the copy; the original slept {HIDING}.
{the_someone} had arranged the whole voyage {MANNER}, to bring {first} home.
The stars outside {landmark:built} were projections by {SOMEONE:!plural}, and {place} had never left orbit.
{the_thing:portable} was a seed vault, and {CLOSE:human} had carried it {MANNER} for years.
Every log mentioning {TOPIC} had been edited by the {rival}, out of {MOTIVE}.
